data.one_liner: A portable Markdown library written in Dart that parses Markdown into AST and HTML.
data.what_it_does: Parses Markdown text into an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) complete with location information and renders it to HTML on both the client and server. It provides 100% compliance with CommonMark and GitHub Flavored Markdown (GFM), while supporting custom syntax extensions.
use_when: You need to parse Markdown into an AST with exact location data in Dart.
You want to render Markdown to HTML on either the client or server.
avoid_when: You are looking for a complete rich-text editor or Markdown widget implementation for UI.
strengths: 100% conform to CommonMark and GFM specifications.
Outputs AST with precise location information (line, column, offset) for text and markers.
Supports custom syntax extensions via custom syntax classes.
weaknesses: Does not include built-in UI widgets for displaying Markdown in a Flutter app out of the box.
